label: FT Control
info:
# OPC UA Suite - Function Test Suite

Self-running functional tests for every node of node-red-contrib-opcua-suite.

Targets (docker compose service names):
- OPC UA test server: opc.tcp://opcua-server:4840/UA/TestServer
- MQTT broker: mqtt://val-mosquitto:1883
- embedded opcua-server node: opc.tcp://localhost:48410/UA/NodeRED

The suite starts 8 s after deploy and can be restarted with the inject node.
Results: debug sidebar, Node-RED log lines starting with [FT], and
GET /opcua-functest/results (JSON).

Automated run: npm run test:functional (see docker-compose.test.yml).

Generated by test/functional/build-flow.js. Edit the generator, not this file.

label: FT Node Overview
info:
Every node type of node-red-contrib-opcua-suite on one tab.

Test N01 passes one message through all nine flow node types in a row.
The two config node types (opcua-endpoint, opcua-pubsub-connection) are
listed in the Configuration nodes sidebar.

The comments above the test list, per node type, every test using it.
